brief:
Israel has barred supplies needed to treat a six-year-old burn victim in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The child, identified as Masa, is among patients whose recovery faces jeopardy due to Israeli restrictions on medical materials entering the territory.

The restrictions have created obstacles for medical care in Gaza, where healthcare infrastructure continues to face severe constraints amid the ongoing conflict.

title: Israel blocks medical supplies for Gaza burn victim child
